newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Genbel changes abbreviated name to Gensa.
newsitem.headline: Genbel changes abbreviated name to Gensa.

text.p: Genbel South Africa Limited (Genbel) announced on Thursday it had changed its abbreviated name to Gensa.
The name change would be take effect from March 3 on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) list, but its JSE short code "GBL" would remain unchanged.
It said the reason for it changing its abbreviated name was that there were a number of companies which traded with the prefix Genbel and that Gensa wanted to create a separate identity.
The change of the abbreviated name would not require any action to be taken by shareholders, it said.
